summary: PR #5459 adds the opstack-executor header-only library (part 3/7) with consensus-grade deposit envelope decoding, transaction conversion, and block execution lifecycle. The architecture is well-organized with clear module boundaries. However: (1) CI is broken due to CMake `PRIVATE` on an INTERFACE library, (2) a buffer overread vulnerability exists in access-list/authorization-list processing, and (3) several consensus-critical code paths lack unit tests.

items.title: CMake target_compile_options uses PRIVATE on INTERFACE library
items.description: opstack-executor is declared as INTERFACE library (line 25) but target_compile_options uses PRIVATE scope (line 39). CMake rejects this: 'target_compile_options may only set INTERFACE properties on INTERFACE targets.' This breaks CI on all platforms.
items.expected_impact: CI will pass cmake configure step

items.title: Access-list and authorization-list buffer overread on short account/address fields
items.description: std::copy_n(entry.account.begin(), sizeof(evmc_address), addr.bytes) at line ~533 assumes entry.account is ≥20 bytes. A malformed tars Transaction with a shorter account field causes out-of-bounds read. Same pattern for storageKeys (expects 32 bytes, line ~538) and authorizationList[].address (expects 20 bytes, line ~585).
items.expected_impact: Prevents buffer overread from adversarial input

items.title: preBlockOpSteps has ~8 consensus-rejection branches but zero unit tests
items.description: The preBlockOpSteps template (OpBlockExecute.h) contains rejection branches for: empty block, missing deposit, non-L1-attributes deposit, wrong Jovian selector, short L1 attributes data, non-deposit trailing tx, DA scalar extraction. All are compile-tested only via SmokeCompileTest — no behavioral tests.
items.fix_suggestion: Add unit tests for each rejection branch and the happy path (DA scalar extraction).

items.title: mismatchedFieldOf (8-way commitment comparison) has no unit test
items.description: The mismatchedFieldOf function (OpCommitments.h:305) compares receiptsRoot, logsBloom, withdrawalsRoot, stateRoot, gasUsed, txRoot, blobGasUsed, requestsHash. No unit test verifies field ordering, bidirectional optional comparison, or the reported field name strings.
items.fix_suggestion: Add tests for: each field mismatch individually, presence asymmetry (announced-only vs computed-only), and matching commitments returning nullopt.
items.expected_impact: Catches drift in the core consensus gate

items.title: hexCumulative and txTypeByte classification are untested
items.description: hexCumulative (OpCommon.h) feeds receipt root leaves and txTypeByte feeds tx-type classification for receipts root. Neither has a unit test. A regression in either would silently produce wrong receiptsRoot.
items.fix_suggestion: Add tests for hexCumulative(0), hexCumulative(UINT64_MAX), txTypeByte(0x7e), txTypeByte(0x00), txTypeByte(0x01/0x02/0x04), and legacy (>=0xc0).

items.title: chainId validation logic has no unit test
items.description: The chainId validation in m_prepare (line ~1212) exempts legacy unprotected txs (chain_id==0) but requires strict match for typed txs. This is consensus-critical (cross-chain replay guard) but untested.
items.fix_suggestion: Add tests for: legacy exempt (chain_id=0), legacy protected match, legacy protected mismatch, typed match, typed mismatch.

items.title: commitmentsOf and announcedCommitmentsOf projection functions are untested
items.description: The type conversions (evmc::bytes32→h256, BloomFilter→h2048) and the projection functions are called per-block but never verified in isolation. A byte-order inversion would cause every block to fail validation.
items.fix_suggestion: Add round-trip tests for toBcosH256/toBcosBloom and value-level tests for commitmentsOf/announcedCommitmentsOf.

items.title: Blob tx (kind=3) and access-list tx (kind=1) data passthrough untested
items.description: OpTxConvertTest only exercises legacy and eip1559 with actual fee data. The blob hash copy loop and access list copy loop in toEvmoneTransaction have no test with populated data.
items.fix_suggestion: Add tests for blob tx with blob_versioned_hashes and access-list tx with populated access list entries.
items.expected_impact: Catches off-by-one in blob/access-list data copying

analysis.correctness: The deposit envelope decoder (decodeDepositEnvelope) is consensus-grade with correct field ordering matching op-geth, thorough width bounds and canonicality checks (~15 rejection branches), and proper gas > INT64 overflow guard. The toEvmoneTransaction handles all three `to` forms correctly. The chainId validation logic correctly exempts legacy unprotected txs. One buffer overread vulnerability in access-list/authorization-list processing.
analysis.architecture: Well-organized header-only module with clear boundaries: OpstackExecutor (executor lifecycle), OpBlockExecute (block-pre steps), OpCommitments (consensus comparison), OpCommon (types), RecentBlockHashes (lazy block hashes), Storage2State (storage bridge). The TransactionExecutor concept implementation with prepare/execute/finish lifecycle is clean. The SERIAL-ONLY constraint on OpBlockExecutionContext is documented.
analysis.security: Buffer overread in access-list/authorization-list processing (std::copy_n without size check). The const_cast on deposit envelope input is safe today but latent risk. The deposit decoder correctly validates all fields against adversarial input. RecentBlockHashes noexcept wrapper catches all exceptions including bad_alloc.
analysis.performance: No performance concerns identified. RecentBlockHashes uses lazy loading with a map cache. Storage2State's probeHasStorage has a documented TODO for optimization (full range scan per modified account).
analysis.test_coverage: Good coverage for deposit envelope decode (~15 negative cases + positive anchors) and tx conversion (kind mapping, to field forms, chainId parsing). Significant gaps in: preBlockOpSteps (8 rejection branches), mismatchedFieldOf (8-way comparison), hexCumulative/txTypeByte, chainId validation, commitmentsOf/announcedCommitmentsOf projections.
